summary_1line: The aged vulture king Jatayu confronts Ravana, condemns the abduction of Sita, and challenges him to battle to defend Rama’s wife.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged vulture king Jatayu perches on a tree, wings spread and beak raised, confronting Ravana in his chariot as Sita looks on in distress.
Jatayu, towering with ragged wings and fierce eyes, challenges the armored Ravana carrying Sita in a golden chariot in the forest sky.
The ancient bird king stands defiantly before Ravana’s chariot, declaring his challenge while the forest winds whip around Sita’s flowing garments.
